entries.description: A GENERATOR_SET can now be driven by a gas turbine or diesel engine (TYPE GAS_TURBINE_DRIVEN/DIESEL_ENGINE_DRIVEN) combined with a GENERATOR_EFFICIENCY, instead of only a direct power-to-fuel curve.
Named operating phases with a WHEN expression that references a time series or variable and evaluates to true or false in every period. Phases are not used by other parts of the model yet.
A list in which each inlet stream is identified by its NAME, instead of a mapping keyed by name. Names must be unique. To migrate, drop each key and keep its entry, with its NAME, as a list item.
A list in which each process pipeline is identified by its NAME, instead of a mapping keyed by name. Names must be unique. To migrate, drop each key and keep its entry, with its NAME, as a list item.
Renamed to GENERATOR_SET. The curve-based MODEL is unchanged; rename the unit's TYPE from GENERATOR to GENERATOR_SET.

FACILITY_INPUTS is only available in legacy models. Define compressor charts in DEFINITIONS.COMPRESSOR_MODELS, performance curves in DEFINITIONS.PERFORMANCE_CURVES and pump charts in DEFINITIONS.PUMP_MODELS, using FILE for data in a file.

To migrate, define the pump in PUMPS and its chart as a pump model in DEFINITIONS.PUMP_MODELS (or inline as MODEL), instead of referencing a chart in FACILITY_INPUTS. Place the pump in a pump pipeline in PUMP_PIPELINES. Move INLET to a liquid inlet stream in STREAM_DISTRIBUTION of a pump simulation in PUMP_SIMULATIONS, with RATE given as VALUE and UNIT, and OUTLET_PRESSURE to CONSTRAINTS of that pipeline. A choke is no longer implied: set PRESSURE_CONTROL to DOWNSTREAM_CHOKE to keep the previous results.
Whether a model is NextGen or legacy is decided by how it is run, not by the YAML file. Remove YAML_VERSION from existing files.
